title: MaxMap
description: Tracks Your Mapped areas and auto maps for you
body: Ever started a huge mapping project and then lost track of which 128×128 map tiles you’ve already covered? MaxMap is a Fabric client-side mod that gives you a live coverage overlay showing which map tiles are mapped and which are still unexplored — making large-scale mapping projects simple and efficient. MaxMap is a fork / continuation of Map Coverage Tracker, expanded with modern Fabric support and several quality-of-life improvements.## ![Logo](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/701789077352c807a25f5c831eb94ec22322819a_0.webp) ✨Features - Live overlay showing coverage of 128×128 map tiles - Green cells = mapped tiles - Red cells = unmapped tiles - Auto-map mode (automatically creates and checks maps) - Automatically moves scanned maps into your main inventory - HUD coverage percentage display - Red HUD warning when inventory is full - Configurable overlay size & placement - Clickable cells (jump focus / inspect area) - Lightweight & client-side only --- ## ⌨️ Keybinds | Key | Action | |----|------| | **M** | Open MaxMap configuration screen | | **(Configurable)** | Toggle overlay | | **(Configurable)** | Toggle auto-map mode | > All keybinds can be changed in Minecraft Controls → MaxMap --- ## ⚙️ Configuration Options Inside the MaxMap config screen you can: - Change overlay size (cell scale) - Move overlay position - Enable / disable overlay - Enable / disable auto-map - Adjust scan area coordinates - Fine-tune visual appearance --- ## 📦 Requirements - Minecraft (Fabric) - Fabric Loader - Fabric API --- ## 📸 Screenshots --- ## 📜 Credits - Original mod: **fweigel-dev / MapCoverageTracker** - Continuation & expansion: **MaxVulpes** --- ## 🧾 License This project is released under the MIT License. --- ## 🐛 Issues & Suggestions Found a bug or have an idea? Open an issue on GitHub: https://github.com/MaxVulpes/MaxMap --- ## ❤️ Support If you enjoy MaxMap, consider starring the project on GitHub or sharing it with others!
